title: Gap junctions bind cells into larger selves

statements.text: Gap junctions link cells' internal milieus and wipe the ownership information on signaling molecules. This partly erases the cells' separate identities, drives cooperation, and yields tissue and organ-level selves with anatomical goals.

sources.quote: Gap junctions are a unique scaling mechanism which, by linking cells' internal milieus, wipes ownership information on signaling molecules.
